༄༅/ /mdo sngags chos brgyud kyi bla rabs bshad pa dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mdo sngags chos brgyud kyi bla rabs bshad pa dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs/

na mo mañju gho ṣā su ma ti kīrti yamatha' yas legs tshogs tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sku/ /drug cu'i tshangs dbyangs dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor chos phung brgyad khri sgrogs pa'i gsung*/ /ma lus chos kun kun nas bsgribs med chags thogs mi mnga' mkhyen pa'i thugs/ / lhar bcas 'gro 'dren 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gon de'i mdo sngags dam chos ma lus pa/ /legs par bzung nas 'gro rnams smin grol la/ /'god mdzad rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs gsang bdag sogs/ /byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogs bcas la 'dud/ /'dul ba mngon pa dbu phar gzhung rnams dang*/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dgongs 'grel zhing*/ /nyams su len mdzad shing rta che gnyis sogs/ / 'phags bod paṇa grub rim par byon rnams bsngags/ /de ltar mchod par brjod pa mdo tsam du sngon du btang nas mdo sngags kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen gyi rim pa ji ltar byon pa'i tshul mtshon tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ lo rgyus bcas rgyas par bshad na ni pusta ka chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de la 'dul ba'i brgyud rim/ mngon pa gong 'og gi brgyud rim/ dbu phar gyi brgyud rim/ gsang sngags kyi brgyud rim dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba'i gzhung mang du gsungs shing nyan thos chen po rnams kyis 'chad nyan dang nyams len gyis bzung la/ 'on kyang 'dul ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs ni 'phags pa nye bar 'khor la gtad do/ /rjes su rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhir gyes pa'i tshe nyan thos mang pos 'phags pa sgra gcan 'dzin dang 'od srung chen po sogs bzhi'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa spel/ mdor na 'phags yul du ni nye bar 'khor dang shā ri'i bu dang 'od srung dang kun dga' bo sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang*/ phyis 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras rnams dang*/

thogs med sku mched sogs dang khyad par du slob dpon yon tan 'od dang shākya 'od dang chos kyi bshes gnyen sogs kyis 'dul ba'i bstan pa spel lo/ /bod kyi yul du ni sngon rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang po dang*/ khyad par mkhan po bho dhi satwa spyan drangs nas bai ro tsa na dang nam mkha'i snying po sogs sad mi mi drug bdun rab tu byung nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa'i gzhi btsugs/ phyis rgyal po glang dar gyis bstan pa la gnod pa byas pa'i rkyen gyis dbus su sdom pa len pa'i rgyun chad kyang*/ mdo smad du bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs kyis 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun bzung nas 'ga' zhig la spel/ de'i skad cha dbus su byung ba la brten nas dbus gtsang phyogs nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi ched du klu mes sogs 'ga' zhig brdzangs te bsnyan par rdzogs nas slar 'ongs/ de nas rim par brgyud pa la 'dul ba smad lugs pa'i brgyud par grags/ yang mnga' bdag ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmāḥpā la mnga' ris su spyan drangs nas mang po zhig bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba'i lag len btsugs pa'i bslab rgyun 'dzin pa rnams la 'dul ba stod lugs pa'i brgyud par grags/ yang khro phu lo ts+tsha bas kha che paṇa chen bod du gdan drangs nas sa skya paṇa chen sogs mang po zhig bsnyen par rdzogs pas de'i brgyud pa la paṇa chen brgyud par grags shing*/ rje rin po ches kyang brgyud pa 'di las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes la/ da lta gtsang phyogs kyi sdom rgyun la paṇa chen brgyud pa dar che bar sems/ des na 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun byon lugs la rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang*/ rje'i gsan yig las/ 'dul ba'i bshad rgyud ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ nye bar 'khor/ des kun dga' bo/ nyer sbas/ dhi dhi ka nag po/ legs mthong*/ phyir mi 'ong blos mi 'bebs/

'dus bzang*/ dbyig gnyen/ slob dpon yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od/ dgra bcom seṅge'i gdong pa can/ des dā na shī la dang dzi na mi tra gnyis la/ des shākya seṅge/ skyogs 'dul 'dzin/ rdzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rdzus kyis klu mes la'ang gsan te yas dar mas dar gnyis su byas pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ lung rigs gter mdzod du dzi na mi tra'i rjes su lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ gtsang rab gsal/ g.yo dge 'byung*/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ gzu ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sne po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sog ston tshul khrims bla ma/ rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims/ rma tsho byang chub rdo rje/ skyid shod pa tshul khrims 'phags/ 'dar tshul khrims rgyal po/ nyi steng ba tshul khrims grags/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros grags/ nel pa paṇa chen/ 'dul 'dzin rgyal mtshan dpal/ slob dpon rin chen byang chub/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen/ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas 'phel zhes bshad de smad brgyud pa'i dbang du mdzad do/ /stod brgyud pa la dzi na mi tra yan sngar ltar la/ de nas dharmāḥpha la/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya se na/ klubs lots+tsha/ sgyogs 'dul 'dzin/ gzu rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims byang chub/ tshul khrims gnas/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ shes rab 'od zer/ tshul khrims bla ma/ rin chen bla ma/ ye shes bla ma/ rgya 'dul/ rma tsho/ bya 'dul/ tshul khrims 'phags/ sha mi/ rtsibs 'dul ba 'dzin pa sogs so/ / paṇa chen brgyud pa la rnam grangs mang yang*/ sangs rgyas/ shā ri'i bu/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ klu sgrub/ yon tan bshes gnyen/ rin chen bshes gnyen/ chos bzang po/ gu ṇa pa ti/ chos kyi phreng ba/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ paṇa chen shākya shri/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gzungs dpal/ dge legs dpal bzang*/ ā nan+da/ chos rin chen/ chos rgya mtsho/ chos rgyal dpal 'byor/

nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dbang phyugasangs rgyas 'od zer/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen/ grags pa rnam rgyal/ bsod nams bkra shis/ bsod nams mchog grub sogs so/ /rje'i gsan yig tu/ shākya shri'i rjes su/ rdo rje dpal/ mkhan po chos rje/ bsod nams dpal/ shes rab mgon po/ tshul khrims rin chen/ des rje la gnang bar bshad de brgyud tshul gcig go /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i las chog tu gangs can ljongs 'di'i sdom rgyun snga phyi mtha' dag shing rta chen po klu sgrub 'di nyid las brgyud ces bshad do/ /gnyis pa mngon pa gong 'og gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyis mngon pa'i gzhung thor bu thor bur gsungs pa rnams la shā ri'i bu sogs dgra bcom pa bdun gyis don bsdus pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa la mngon pa sde bdun du grags/ des na dgra bcom pa bdun po de rnams mngon pa'i bla brgyud yin la/ mngon pa spyi'i dbang du byas na 'od srung chen pos mngon pa'i gzhung bsdus pa yin no/ /phyis sangs rgyas gnyis pa dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis 'dus bzang las mngon pa gsan nas mngon pa sde bdun gyi don gces gces rnams bsdus pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod ces bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po 'di mdzad do/ /de'i slob ma la mngon pa'i brgyud 'dzin mang yang gtso bo ni blo brtan zhabs yin la/ 'grel pa'i bla brgyud rgya gar na gangs spel dang rgyal po sras sogs mang zhing*/ bod du ni mdzod kyi 'chad nyan ches dar bas bla brgyud kyang de bzhin no/ /thogs med zhabs kyis theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'i gnad bsdus pa'i mngon pa kun las btus pa mdzad de mngon pa gong ma zhes grags so/ /brgyud pa ni thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang sogs so/ / rje'i gsan yig tu/ rigs pa'i mngon pa'i dbang du mdzad de/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ chos skyob/

ma waṃ ga /dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang*/ chos grags/ lha dbang blo/ shākya blo/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ chos mchog /dza ma ri/ dul ba'i lha/ shaṅka rā nan+ta/ waṃ gu /shākya shrī/ sa skya ba/ rigs pa'i seng ge zhes bshad de tshad ma rigs pa'i bla brgyud kyang yin no/ /lung dang rigs pa'i mngon pa'i bla brgyud kyi khyad par gang zhe na/ dgra bcom bdun dang*/ chos skyob/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ gangs spel/ rgyal po sras sogs ni lung gi mngon pa'i bla brgyud dang*/ 'jam dbyangs/ phyogs glang*/ chos grags/ lha dbang blo/ shākya blo/ sher 'byung*/ chos mchog sogs ni rigs pa'i mngon pa'i bla brgyud do/ /gal te lung gi mngon pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing dgra bcom pa rnams kyis bsdus pa yin la/ rigs pa'i mngon pa ni gang las bshad snyam na/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yin te/ mdo du ma las gang skyes pas chos can de 'jig pa'i chos can du gsungs pa sogs kyis gtan tshigs rigs pa bstan cing*/ de ci'i phyir zhe na zhes pa'i lan du de'i phyir ro zhes rgyu mtshan bstan pa rnams kyis kyang gtan tshigs bstan pas mtshon te rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams ni gtan tshigs rigs pa bstan pa shin tu mang ngo*/ /gsum pa dbu phar gyi brgyud rim ni/ spyir dbu phar zhes so sor grags kyang don la dbu ma ni phar phyin gyi lta ba ston pa'i gzhung yin pas phar phyin du 'dus so/ /de yang phar phyin brgyud pa la spyod pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ lta ba'i brgyud pa gnyis su nges shing*/ brgyud pa'i gzhi ni sangs rgyas nas yin la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus su lta spyod kyi brgyud pa so so ba ma byung yang*/ sangs rgyas kyis byams pa la spyod pa'i brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo dang*/ 'jam dbyangs la lta ba'i brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bor don gyis bstan cing*/ thogs med dang klu sgrub gnyis kyi chos brgyud kyang de gnyis nas byung ste/

byams pas thogs med la spyod pa'i phyogs gtso bor bshad cing*/ 'jam dbyangs kyis klu sgrub la lta ba'i phyogs gtso bor bshad pas brgyud pa de gnyis so so'i thog mar gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /byams pas mdo sde'i rgyan las sems tsam lugs kyi lta ba gtso bor bshad kyang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla ma gnyis las ni dbu ma'i lta ba gtso bor bshad pas lta spyod gnyis ka'i brgyud pa yang yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang mdo sde'i rgyan gnyis las spyod pa'i phyogs gtso bor bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa'i tshe rab 'byor gyis bshad pa dang zhus pa mang la/ shā ri'i bu/ gang po/ brgya byin dang*/ byams pas kyang zhus shing gsungs pa snang yang*/ 'jam dbyangs kyis zhus pa ma byung ngo*/ / 'jam dbyangs kyis sher phyin bdun brgya pa'i nang du lta ba'i phyogs mang du gsungs shing*/ dkon brtsegs dang mdo mang gi gzhung mang po na lta ba'i phyogs bshad pa shin tu mang ngo*/ /gal te 'jam dbyangs lta ba'i brgyud 'dzin gyi thog ma yin 'dug cing*/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ni lta ba ston pa'i gzhung thams cad kyi gtso bo yin pas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa'i 'khor du 'jam dbyangs 'ong dgos rgyur snang yang ma byung ba de ci zhig snyam na/ dogs pa de ni bden yang skyon med de/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo la rab 'byor byung zhing*/ de nyid 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin pas so/ / rab 'byor 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul par ci ltar shes zhe na/ shes te/ thub dbang zhal pad ma'i tshigs bcad dang pos rab 'byor bstan cing*/ gnyis pas rigs ldan grags pa rab 'byor gyi skye brgyud du bstan la/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa ni 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa dngos yin par tshad ldan du mas bshad pa las shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bla brgyud ni/

sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ thogs med/ ār+ya de ba/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ seṅge bzang po/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ zla ba grags pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo chen po sogs so/ /de ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ gzhan yang rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba mang ngo*/ /gzhan yang byams pa nas brgyud pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs nas brgyud pa gnyis te/ dang po la/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mchog sde/ dul ba'i sde/ rnam snang mdzad/ seng bzang*/ ku sa li che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa sogs dang*/ gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ zla ba grags pa/ rigs pa'i khu byug che chung*/ jo bo rje sogs so/ /yang na/ klu sgrub/ zla ba grags zhes sogs bya ste rgyas bsdus so/ /yang*/ phar phyin la dbu sems kyi brgyud pa gnyis byung ba ltar na/ sems tsam ston pa la/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ phyogs glang*/ chos grags la sogs pa ste mang ngo*/ /dbu ma ba la rang rgyud pa dang*/ thal 'gyur ba gnyis te/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed dang*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs gnyis ma byon gong du dbu sems gnyis so sor mi gcod kyang*/ slob dpon de gnyis kyis thogs med dang klu sgrub kyi lugs mi 'dra ba'i so so ba'o zhes byas nas lta ba'i sgo nas dbu ma'i lugs la gnyis su phye'o/ /de'i rjes su slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos rang rgyud kyi srol legs ldan dang cung mi 'dra ba zhes byas nas bshad/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi lugs thun mong ma yin pa sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis bshad pa ltar yin no zhes byas nas de'i rjes su 'brangs nas lta ba 'chad de/ jo bo rje yang zla ba'i rjes su 'brang la/ rjes kyang zla ba'i lugs nyid gzhir mdzad nas lta ba 'chad cing rang cag kyang 'di'i rjes su 'brang ngo*/

/'on kyang sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi lta ba 'dzin pa'i slob dpon gyi gtso bo ni/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ phyogs glang*/ chos grags sogs mang zhing*/ lta ba de la brten nas grub pa thob pa ni mkhas pa shan+ti pa la sogs pa mang du snang ngo*/ /spyir dbu sems gnyis re re la yang lta spyod gnyis re ste/ dbu sems gnyis kyi lta ba thun mong ma yin pa 'gal yang spyod phyogs ni dbu sems gnyis ka thun mong ba yin te/ mdo sde'i rgyan nas bshad pa'i phyin drug sogs spyod phyogs rnams dbu ma pas kyang nyams su len dgos par rje nyid kyis bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /klu sgrub dang thogs med lugs kyi gdams pa'i chu bo chen po gcig tu 'dres pa ni jo bo rje nas yin la/ de yang jo bos gser gling pa la brten nas byams pa dang thogs med sku mched nas brgyud pa dang*/ ku sa li che chung brten nas klu sgrub dang zla grags nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa gsan nas bod du bka' gdams bstan pa'i srol btsugs so/ /rje nyid kyis kyang*/ shing rta chen po gnyis las legs brgyud pa'i/ /zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod pa'i lam/ /ma nor yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad bsdus pa/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mar me mdzad la 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /jo bo rjes nas 'brom ston rin po che dang*/ de nas brgyud pa mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang yang gcig ni/ dgon pa pa/ sne'u zur pa/ thag ma pa/ nam mkha' seng ge nam mkha' rgyal po/ seng ge bzang*/ rgyal sras bzang po/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rje rin po che sogs so/ /yang gcig ni jo bo/ 'brom ston/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad kha pa/ spyil bu pa/ lha chen po/ lha 'gro ba'i mgon po/ zangs chen pa/ mtsho sna pa/ mon gra pa/ chos skyob bzang po/ rje'o/ /'di dag lam rim dang lam sgron brgyud pa dang*/ phar phyin brgyud pa yang yin no/ /rje nas rgyal tshab/ mkhas grub/ 'dul 'dzin/ shes rab seng ge sogs la brgyud pa mang yang*/

mdor na gtsang phyogs dang dbus phyogs su brgyud pa gnyis so/ /'on kyang rje btsun shes rab seng ge nas gtsang dang dbus gnyis la brgyud pa ni da lta grags che la/ blo sbyong gi brgyud pa 'ga' re snang ste phar phyin gyi brgyud pa'i phyogs so/ /de dag ni nyams len brgyud pa'i dbang du byas la/ phar phyin gyi bshad srol 'chad nyan gyi brgyud pa da lta mngon rtogs rgyan ṭīk+ka spyi don mtha' gcod la thos bsam byed pa ni/ ser 'bras dge gsum dang bkra shis lhun po la sogs grwa sa thams cad du dar ro/ /bzhi pa sngags phyogs kyi brgyud pa la rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi bla brgyud dang bzhi las/ dang po la/ gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi bla brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze ta ri/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen pa/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khang ston/ sangs rgyas sras/ bde ba can pa/ seng rgyal ba/ rgyang to ba/ shang ston pa/ rtogs ldan pa/ rje'o/ /yang bsam gtan phyi ma dang legs grub kyi brgyud rim ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze ta ri/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa nas rje'i bar ro/ /de dag ni bya ba spyi'i brgyud pa yin la/ so so'i brgyud pa mang yang mtshon tsam zhig gdugs dkar dbang brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas/ gdugs dkar/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ gi ra wa ti/ rdo rje rnon po/ pad+ma lcags kyu/ rin chen rdo rje/ sad dza na/ mahā dza na/ lcags ston/ bstan pa ye dbang*/ gdong ston/ spu ston sogs nas rje'o/ /rnam rgyal lha dgu'i dbang brgyud gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje ba/ sa lung pa/ rgan mo lhas pa nas/ bu ston/ grags she ba/ rje sogs so/ /tshe dpag med lha dgu ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze ta ri/

bho dhi bha dra/ ting 'dzin bzang*/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ mchims brtson seng nas/ bla ma chos dpal pa/ rje rin po che sogs dang*/ yang*/ tshe dpag med/ snying po'i zhabs/ dze ta ri/ byang chub bzang*/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba nas/ chos rje don rin pa/ rje rin po che sogs so/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze ta ri/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ lo chen rin chen bzang*/ chos blo/ wang khri/ sgrog ston nas/ bu ston/ khyung lhas/ rje rin po che sogs so/ /rnam 'joms kyi bla brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ sa ba ri ba/ dza ba ri ba/ de ba bud+dha ma ti/ chos bzang po sogs so/ /gnyis pa spyod rgyud kyi brgyud rim ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze ta ri/ a shwa ka shrī/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri ba/ mchims brtson seng nas/ bu ston rin po che/ khyung chen pa/ rje rin po che sogs so/ / spyod rgyud 'di bya rgyud ltar dar so che bar mi snang bas brgyud pa yang nyung ngo*/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor yo ga'i bla ma'i brgyud rim la mang po zhig 'dug kyang gtso bo 'ga' zhig brjod na/ rdo rje dbyings kyi bka' dbang dang*/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i bshad bka'i brgyud rim ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ dpa' bo rta phal/ ye shes rdo rje/ kun dga' snying po/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ dharmāḥpā la/ lo chen/ brtson rgyal nas/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ khyung chen pa/ rje sogs so/ /dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag rdor/ rab zla gsal/ rgyal po sgra gcan 'dzin/ kun snying*/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ dharmā pā la nas/ khyung lhas/ rje sogs so/ /gtsug dgu'i dbang brgyud gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dz+nyā na shrī mi tra/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ a bh+ya ya ka ra/ rdo rje gdan pa na/ rje sogs so/

/kun rig gi dbang brgyud ni/ rnam snang*/ dze ta ri/ kun snying*/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ nā ya ka mai tri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ niska laṃ ka re wan+t+ra/ chag chos rje dpal/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ lo mchogadapal ldan pa/ bu ston/ khyung lhas pa/ rje sogs so/ /rgyud 'grel gyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon kun snying*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ka ma dhe nu/ rdo rje go cha sogs so/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ kun snying*/ pradz+nyā sid+dhi/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ shrad+dha ka ra/ pad+ma kā ra nas/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /mtshan brjod la rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med kyi brgyud tshul gnyis bshad kyang*/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ a ba dhū tī pa/ gnyis med sbas pa/ sgeg rdor/ smṛ ti/ tsaṇ+ḍa go mi la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa bla med kyi bla ma'i brgyud rim la rnam grangs mang yang gtso bo rnams brjod na/ thog mar 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ lā li ta/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas spas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī baṃ kā ra/ rdo rje grags pa/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng ge rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ bla ma ye shes dpal/ chos rje don rin pa/ rje rin po che sogs te/ brgyud tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /gshed dmar lha lnga'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bhir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bhi ba/ bi ra ṭi pa/ ma ti pa/ nīska laṃ ka re wan+t+ra/ chag lo/ g.yung phug pa sogs so/ /gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal 'dzin/ bi ra ṭi pa/ ma ti pa sogs dang*/ gshed dmar gyi rnal 'byor bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed/ dpal 'dzin/ bi ṭi pa/ ma ti pa/ dza ma ri/ darba na ā tsar+ya/ sa pa/ lo mchog nas/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi brgyud pa ni/

sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ bud+dha shrī dz+nyā na/ dī paṃ ka ra bha dra/ nā+e la badz+ra/ su hu su ra pa/ sha na na/ a pa li na pa nas/ gtan bzang ba/ rje sogs so/ /rtog bdun dang rtog gsum gyi brgyud rim ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ḍā ki ma/ lā li ta/ a mo gha badz+ra nas/ dpal ldan seng ge rgyang to pa/ zhang ston/ rtogs ldan pa/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi bla brgyud ni/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong can/ sha ba ri/ dza wa ri/ de ba bud+dha ma ti/ 'gar chos bzang*/ rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos rgyal/ shes rab bla ma/ sher 'bum nas rje la sogs pa'o/ /kyai rdor gyi bla brgyud gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma rū pa/ a wa dhū tī ba/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa/ sa skya pa/ slob dpon pa/ rje btsun chen po/ bla ma chos rje/ bla ma 'phags pa/ mchog ldan pa/ dpal ldan pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog rin chen/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /gdan bzhi'i brgyud rim ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma shrī/ ri bha ba/ su man shrī/ rat+na kā ra/ a ma la bha dra/ pha la shrī/ su ma na shrī/ bu ston/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sogs dang*/ gzhan yang de'i dbang brgyud la/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ sher bzang*/ su la ha ri ba/ mar pa lots+tsha sogs dang*/ yang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag rdor/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa nas rje la sogs pa'o/ /saṃ bhu ṭi la brgyud lugs gsum las/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma skal bzang*/ gu ru ā tsar+ya/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ 'jigs med grags pa sogs pa dang*/ yang*/ mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po pa/ dha ma pa/ de ba pa/ dze ta ri/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ dharma ka ra ma ti sogs dang*/ yang*/ kyai rdor/ pad+ma badz+ra/ slob dpon pad+ma/ in+d+ra bo dhi chung ba/ legs smin ka ra/ dz+nyā na bho dhi nas rje sogs so/ /sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu ma'i brgyud pa ni/

kyai rdor nas/ chos rje bsod rgyal/ khyung chen pa/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan grags la sogs pa'o/ /ma hā ma ya'i dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje snying po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku re pa/ mtsho skyes/ ḍoṃ bhi ba*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ bal po paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhi ba bzang po/ mar pa chos blo/ rngog chos rdor nas/ rtogs ldan pa/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang dang rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa'i brgyud rim la lnga las/ dang po sa lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag rdor/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lots+tsa ba/ sa chen pa/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa/ rigs pa seṅge/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ legs pa'i blo gros/ dpal ldan pa/ bu ston/ khyung lhas pa/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa jo bo'i lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ shān+ti pa/ jo bo rje/ rong pa mgar dge /lha rje stod pa/ steng shod pa gnyis pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa lo chung lugs ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ lū hi pa/ ḍaiṃ ki pa/ dā ri ka pa/ dril bu pa/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ rus sbal zhabs la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa gnyos lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ lha la dad pa/ pham mthing pa sogs so/ /lnga pa mar do'i lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lū hi pa/ ḍaiṃ ki pa/ lwa wa pa/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ ka tsa pa/ dril bu pa/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po pa/ ku sha la na/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa nas/ bu ston pa/ chos dpal ba/ rje rin po che la sogs pa'o/ /bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag rdor/

sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ lū hi pa nas gong gi dbang brgyud dang 'dra la/ gzhan chos rje sa skya ba/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dga' ldan pa/ dkon mchog dpal/ bsod nams 'bum la sogs pa'o/ /bde mchog dril bu pa'i lus dkyil gyi dbang brgyud la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gong gi sa lugs dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ dril bu ba/ dā ri ka pa/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ a bh+ya ya/ de ba pūr+ṇa/ shākya shrī la sogs pa'o/ /dril bu lha lnga'i dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dril bu pa/ laṅka ling pa/ nag po spyod pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma na ka shrī/ ka na ka shrī/ pham mthing pa/ 'jigs med grags/ su ma ti kīrti/ mar do/ blo ldan seng ge jo bde/ shag rdor/ chos mgon/ lo mchog /dpal ldan pa/ bu ston/ khyung chen pa/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /bde mchog sdom 'byung gi dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri ba/ dpe med dpal/ rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa/ dge ba'i 'byung gnas la sogs pa'o/ /mi tra lugs kyi bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sa ra ha/ mai tri pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mi tra dzo ki khro phu pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsang 'dus la 'phags lugs dang*/ ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis kyi dang po la brgyud tshul 'dun pa bshad kyang 'dir mar 'gos kyi brgyud pa'i dbang du byas na/ mar pa'i lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mtshur ston dbang rdor/ gad pa kīrti/ bsod nams rin chen/ tshul khrims skyabs/ 'phags pa skyabs/ gzhon nu 'od/ dge sdings pa chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ khyung lhas/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /mar lugs kyi grub thob nyams brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bho dhi/

ḍā ki bde ba/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ kam pa la ba/ nag po pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa sogs so/ /de lugs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bho dhi/ sa ra ha pa/ klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa dang*/ yang zla grags/ rig pa'i khu byug /a ba dhū tī pa/ nag po pa/ dri med blo gros/ ye shes snying po la sogs pa'o zhes bshad de/ grub thob brgyud par yang snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa 'gos lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag rdor/ in+d+ra bho dhi/ klu'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi pu kam+pa/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu byang*/ zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ sa 'dres/ mar me mdzad/ de ba a kā ra/ bir+ya bha dra/ rje rin po che*/ 'gos/ mngar ba seṅge rgyal mtshan/ rngog ye shes seṅge/ nye ma seṅge/ ār+ya de ba/ nyi ma lcam/ rin chen grags/ tshul khrims/ 'phags pa skyabs/ chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ khyung lhas pa'am/ yang na/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sgra bsgyur nam mkha' bzang po/ rje btsun re mda' pa chen po/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos bka' babs bdun bshad de/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i 'gos lugs dang 'dra yang rje nas brgyud pa gzhan mang du 'byung*/ bka' babs gnyis pa mar lugs te/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bho dhi/ ḍā ki de ba'i zhabs/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka la sogs pa grub thob nyams brgyud dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa yang mar lugs te/ klu sgrub/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ ma taṃ gi tai lo/ nā ro sogs mi 'dra ba zhig bshad/ bzhi pa jo bo'i lugs te/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bho dhi/ nā ga dzo ki sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ zla grags/ rig pa'i khu byug ku sa li che chung*/ jo bo rje/ rong pa 'gar dge la sogs pa'o/ /lnga pa ni chag lugs te/ klu sgrub nas/ shākya bshes gnyen/ ār+ya de ba/

klu byang*/ rta dbyangs/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ dril bu pa/ dza lan+dha ri ba/ dpe med dpal la sogs pa'o/ /drug pa ni sa lugs te/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag rdor/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla grags/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas la sogs pa'o/ /bdun pa ni dpyal lugs te/ sa lugs dang 'dra yang*/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'od zer shākya/ dar ma shes rab/ rin chen dpal/ rgyal mtshan rin chen la sogs pa'o/ / gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs ni/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ kun dga' snying po/ tha ga na/ shan+ti pa/ shra dha ka ra/ pad+ma kā ra nas/ bu ston/ khyung chen pa/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a bh+ya ka ra/ nā ya ka pa/ da sha pā la/ bi ku ta de ba/ kha che paṇa chen la sogs pa'o/ /dus 'khor gyi brgyud pa la ra 'bro gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas/ zla bzang*/ lha dbang*/ gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha dbang ldan/ 'jam dpal grags/ pad dkar/ tsi lu pa/ biṇ+ḍa ā tsar+ya/ dus zhabs che ba/ mañju kīrti/ sa mān+ta shrī/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge la sogs pa dang*/ 'bro lugs ni/ pad dkar yan sngar ltar la/ bzang po rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang po/ phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug sngas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang*/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong*/ dpal skyong*/ dus zhabs che chung*/ zla mgon dang*/ bla ma chos kyi dpal ba/ rje la sogs pa'o/ /brgyud pa thor bu gzhan 'ga' re yang snang ngo*/ /dus 'khor ni/ rje nas rgyal tshab/ mkhas grub gnyis sogs la brgyud cing*/ mkhas grub rjes dus 'khor ṭīka chen dang*/ de'i thugs sras blo gros chos skyong gis kyang dus 'khor gyi yig cha mdzad do/ /chos rje bu ston yang dus 'khor la mkhas par snang zhing*/

phyis phug pa lhun grub rgya mtshos dus 'khor lugs kyi rtsis kyi yig cha khyad par can pad dkar zhal lung mdzad la/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos kyang rtsis kyi yig cha du ma dang*/ nang nyams len gyi yig cha dri med 'od rgyan mdzad do/ /de rnams ni mdo sngags kyi chos brgyud ji ltar byon pa'i tshul rje'i gsan yig sogs nas 'byung ba thor 'khrugs bsal te rim par bkod pa yin la/ gzhan 'dir ma bkod pa'i chos brgyud mang du yod de/ mdo rgyud kyi lung gi brgyud pa dang*/ ṭīk+ka dang*/ dbang dang*/ rjes gnang dang*/ man ngag gi brgyud pa sna tshogs snang ba rnams ni 'dir 'god par mdzad pa'i phyir te/ bka' bstan 'gyur nas 'byung ba rnams dang*/ bod kyi bla ma du mas mdzad pa'i chos tshan de rnams la'ang brgyud pa sna tshogs yod kyang brjod mi nus pa bzhin no/ /'o na khyed rang la chos brgyud ji ltar yod zhe na/ brjod par bya ste/ chos brgyud kyi bla ma mang po ma bsten kyang slob dpon tshul khrims dar rgyas nas 'dul mdzod dbu phar bsdus gzhung sogs lan mang du thos shing lam rim gyi bshad pa yang thos/ rwa ba stod pa'i slob dpon pa las tshad gzhung gi spyi thal sogs dang*/ rje drung rin po che nas lam rim chen mo dang*/ stong 'khor rin po che nas 'jam dpal zhal lung thos shing*/ grub khang dpon slob/ mnga' ris sprul sku/ rgyud stod bla ma las rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs sngags phyogs 'ga' zhig dang*/ slob dpon bzang po rgyal mtshan nas lam rim chen mo'i lung dang*/ yi dam sgrub skor sogs sngags phyogs kyi skor 'ga' zhig thos/ slob dpon byang chub mi la nas mdo lung 'ga' zhig dang*/ paṇa chen gyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang*/ spyod 'jug dang rigs tshogs drug gi lung dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang dbu ma 'jug pa sogs kyi lung yang thos/ slob dpon khri chen blo bzang dar rgyas nas 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang*/

gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi lung 'khrid dang*/ chos spyod sogs 'ga' zhig dang lcags mkhar skor gyi lung dang yi dam sgrub skor yang thos/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang blo bzang sbyin pa'i zhabs drung nas gsang 'jigs kun rig tshe dpag lha dgu bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang*/ rta mgrin dang khros ma nag mo'i dbang dang*/ tshe dpag med sogs 'dod lha du ma dang chos skyong skor gyi rjes gnang dang dpe lung*/ lam rim dang 'jam dpal zhal lung gi dmar 'khrid dang*/ blo sbyong gi skor dang*/ gsang 'jigs sogs kyi mngon dkyil lung dang*/ rtog bdun dang sman bla dang kun rig snang stong sogs dang*/ smyung gnas dang gcod kyi skor zhig dang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs kyi rjes gnang*/ 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dmar 'khrid dang*/ blo bzang bka' 'bum le tshan 'ga' re dang*/ gzhan mang po zhig zhus pa yod kyang ma bkod/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i drung nas 'jigs byed dpa' gcig dang*/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes gnang dang dbyangs can ma sogs kyi rjes gnang 'ga' re dang*/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum rtsa 'grel dang*/ dbang mdor bstan gyi lung sogs mang du thos/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho'i sku zhabs nas gsang bde gnyis kyi rtsa rgyud kyi lung dang de gnyis kyi dbang dang 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi skor dang*/ sngags rim chen mo'i lung dang*/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi mngon rtogs dang bskyed rdzogs kyi lung ci rigs dang*/ kun rig dang gdugs dkar gyi dbang la sogs pa 'ga' re thos so/ / de ltar na'ang paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung 'bum nas 'dul ba dbu phar gyi snying po bsdus pa mang po dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha'i sgrub thabs du ma dang*/ dkyil chog bskyed rdzogs kyi snying po bsdus pa mang po zhig 'byung bas 'di'i lung rdzogs par thob na mdo sngags kyi gnad mang po thos par 'jog nus so//

// yang mar bshes gnyen dam pa las/ /zab zab dam pa'i chos kyi tshul/ / gang gang brgyud pa de dag gi /grangs dang mtshan tho bsdus te bkod/ /de las thob pa'i rnam dkar dge ba gang*/ /ji snyed mchis des tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob shog /ces mdo sngags kyi chos brgyud pa'i bla ma'i brgyud rim bshad pa 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas dad pas kun nas bslangs te co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo// //maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/mdo sngags chos brgyud kyi bla rabs bshad pa dngos grub 'byung gnasabazhugs/ PAGE 22- - PAGE 21- -- PAGE 1 -
